qualifications: func_00140dac now correctly represents its trailing entry table as e[]; the actual bound and unchecked-index precondition are not recovered. Pilot struct layouts remain partial, consistent with all uses in their respective units rather than fully recovered types. These limitations are published in docs/known-issues-c001-pilot-r3.md, which applies to the unchanged r4 source scope.

game_heap.cpp remains outside mechanical interface checking. The current declarations were manually checked across all current source units and against independently regenerated caller/factory/constructor evidence; the configuration pointer defect is fixed. Heap, Widget and WidgetConfig remain partial or opaque declarations, not a recovered complete class hierarchy.

func_001718ec and func_00171c7c intentionally preserve the original out-of-range uninitialized return, with ORIGINAL BUG comments and published disclosure. No claim is made that valid game callers reach that path or that the source has defined portable behavior for such input.

This review independently reran all seven units sequentially (17 MATCH results, 1096 bytes) and read both prepared fresh-build receipts with equal code.bin and ExeFS .code hashes. It did not rerun the full build or suite. Inherited full original-armlink, unwind, cross-host and lower RomFS IVFC limitations remain as documented in docs/known-issues-c001-pilot-r3.md; exact in-place matching is not a claim that those separate properties are proven.
